privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.intro: This Privacy Policy explains how Staffra AI ("Staffra", "we", "us") collects, uses, shares, and protects personal information when you use our website, dashboard, and services (together, the "Service"). It also describes the choices you have about your information. By using the Service you agree to the practices described here.

sections.heading: 1. Who this policy covers
paragraphs: This policy applies to two groups. First, the businesses and their team members who create a Staffra account to hire and manage AI employees ("Customers"). Second, the end customers of those businesses who exchange messages with an AI employee over channels such as WhatsApp, Instagram, or a website chat ("End Users").

For End User data, the business that operates the AI employee is the controller of that data and Staffra acts as its processor. That business's own privacy policy governs how it uses the conversation data it collects through Staffra.

sections.heading: 2. Information we collect
paragraphs: Account information: name, email address, password, company name, and role, provided when a Customer signs up or is invited to a team.
Business information: the descriptions, policies, product catalog, pricing, opening hours, and other content a Customer adds so its AI employees can answer questions accurately.

Conversation content: the messages, attachments, and contact identifiers (such as a phone number or social handle) exchanged between an End User and an AI employee, along with any appointments, orders, or checkout links generated during a conversation.
Connection data: tokens and account identifiers we store when a Customer connects a third-party channel or tool, such as a messaging platform or a calendar.
Usage and device data: log data, IP address, browser type, pages viewed, and actions taken in the dashboard, collected automatically to operate and secure the Service.
Cookies: we use strictly necessary cookies to keep you signed in and to remember your language preference. We do not use advertising cookies.

sections.heading: 3. How we use information
paragraphs: To provide, maintain, and improve the Service, including letting AI employees answer questions, book appointments, and create checkout links on a Customer's behalf.
To authenticate users, secure accounts, prevent fraud and abuse, and enforce our Terms of Service.
To provide support, respond to requests, and send service-related notices such as security alerts and changes to our terms or policies.
To analyze usage in aggregate so we can understand which features are useful and improve performance and reliability.
To comply with legal obligations and to establish, exercise, or defend legal claims.

sections.heading: 4. Automated processing by AI providers
paragraphs: AI employees generate replies using large-scale language models operated by trusted third-party providers. To produce a response, the relevant conversation content and the business information needed for context are sent to that provider for processing and are returned to Staffra.

Our providers are contractually bound to process this data only to deliver the response and not to use it to train their general models. We do not sell personal information and we do not use conversation content for advertising.

sections.heading: 5. How we share information
paragraphs: Service providers: cloud hosting, database, email delivery, error monitoring, and the AI model providers described above, each acting on our instructions under a data processing agreement.

Messaging and calendar platforms: when a Customer connects a channel such as WhatsApp or Instagram, or a calendar, we exchange the data needed to send and receive messages or manage events through that platform, subject to that platform's own terms.
Payment processors: when a checkout link is used, payment is handled by a third-party processor; Staffra does not collect or store card numbers.
Within a Customer's team: account and conversation data is visible to other authorized members of the same business account, according to their role.
Legal and safety: we may disclose information if required by law, regulation, legal process, or to protect the rights, property, or safety of Staffra, our Customers, or the public.
Business transfers: if Staffra is involved in a merger, acquisition, or sale of assets, information may be transferred as part of that transaction, subject to this policy.

sections.heading: 6. International transfers
paragraphs: Staffra is operated from Brazil and uses infrastructure and providers that may be located in other countries, including the United States and the European Union. Where personal information is transferred across borders, we rely on appropriate safeguards such as standard contractual clauses and the protections offered by our providers.

sections.heading: 7. Data retention
paragraphs: We keep account and business information for as long as a Customer's account is active. Conversation data is retained while it is needed to operate the Service and for a reasonable period afterward for security, dispute resolution, and legal compliance.

A Customer can delete business content and disconnect channels at any time from the dashboard. When an account is closed, we delete or anonymize associated personal information within a reasonable period, except where we must keep it to meet a legal obligation.

sections.heading: 8. Security
paragraphs: We protect information with encryption in transit, access controls, and row-level database policies that isolate each business account's data. Sensitive credentials for connected platforms are stored with restricted server-only access.
No method of transmission or storage is completely secure. If we become aware of a breach that affects your personal information, we will notify you and the relevant authorities as required by law.

sections.heading: 9. Your rights and choices
paragraphs: Depending on where you live, you may have the right to access, correct, delete, or receive a copy of your personal information, to object to or restrict certain processing, and to withdraw consent. Brazilian users have these rights under the LGPD; users in the European Economic Area and the United Kingdom have them under the GDPR.

Customers can exercise most of these rights directly in the dashboard. For anything else, or if you are an End User, contact us using the details below and we will respond within the time required by applicable law. You also have the right to lodge a complaint with your local data protection authority.

sections.heading: 10. Children
paragraphs: The Service is intended for businesses and is not directed to children. We do not knowingly collect personal information from children under 13 (or the minimum age in your jurisdiction). If you believe a child has provided us information, contact us and we will delete it.

sections.heading: 11. Changes to this policy
paragraphs: We may update this policy from time to time. If we make a material change, we will notify Customers by email or through the dashboard before it takes effect. The "last updated" date at the top shows when this version was published.

sections.heading: 12. Contact us
paragraphs: For privacy questions or requests, email privacy@staffra.ai. You can also write to us at the postal address listed on our website.

terms.title: Terms of Service
terms.intro: These Terms of Service ("Terms") are a binding agreement between Staffra AI ("Staffra", "we", "us") and the business or person that uses our website, dashboard, and services (together, the "Service"). By creating an account or using the Service, you agree to these Terms. If you are agreeing on behalf of a company, you represent that you are authorized to bind that company.

sections.heading: 1. The Service
paragraphs: Staffra lets a business hire pre-built AI employees that talk to its customers on its behalf across channels such as WhatsApp, Instagram, and a website chat. Depending on the role, an AI employee can answer questions using information the business provides, book appointments, and create checkout links.
We may add, change, or remove features over time. We will not make material reductions to the core Service for an active paid plan without reasonable notice.

sections.heading: 2. Accounts and eligibility
paragraphs: You must be at least 18 years old and able to form a binding contract. You are responsible for the accuracy of your registration information and for all activity under your account.
You are responsible for keeping your login credentials secure and for the actions of every team member you invite. Notify us promptly of any unauthorized use.

sections.heading: 3. Your responsibilities
paragraphs: You are responsible for the business information you provide and for reviewing how your AI employees represent your business. Keep policies, pricing, and availability up to date.
You must have a lawful basis to message your customers and must obtain any consent required by law before an AI employee contacts them. You are responsible for honoring opt-out requests.
You must comply with the rules of any third-party platform you connect, including the messaging and commerce policies of Meta (WhatsApp and Instagram) and the terms of any payment provider.
You must not use the Service to send spam, unlawful, deceptive, harassing, or harmful content, or to handle categories of sensitive data the Service is not designed for.

sections.heading: 4. AI-generated content
paragraphs: Replies produced by an AI employee are generated automatically and may be inaccurate, incomplete, or not appropriate for every situation. They are not professional, legal, medical, or financial advice.

You are responsible for the messages your AI employees send. We recommend monitoring conversations, keeping a human available to step in, and pausing an AI employee if it is not behaving as you expect. Staffra is not liable for decisions made or actions taken based on AI-generated content.

You represent that you have the rights needed to provide Customer Content and that it does not infringe the rights of others or violate any law.

A third-party platform may suspend or limit access to its APIs at any time, which can affect the Service. We are not liable for such disruptions.

paragraphs: Paid plans, if applicable to your account, are billed in advance on the cycle shown at checkout and are non-refundable except where required by law. We may change pricing with at least 30 days' notice before your next renewal.

Fees charged to your customers through checkout links are processed by a third-party payment provider and settled to you according to that provider's terms. Staffra is not a party to those transactions and does not hold your funds.
